sequential_dependency.intermediate: For every strip, the recovered source block plus its exact marker count; marked strips in this case carry counts 3, 1, and 2.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Infer each zero-strip source side, recover its complete 3x3 source block, and count marker-colored cells inside that recovered block.

sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The destination start is source_start plus or minus 3 times the Step-A count. Replacing every count with one moves the count-2 and count-3 blocks to different final cells under fresh protected Racket execution.
